title: Dental PPO Plans Coinsurance Schedule by Service Class and Network
content:
Coinsurance under the Dental PPO Plans is the whole-number percentage of the allowance that the plan pays. The percentage depends on the line's service class (preventive, basic or major) and on whether the treating practice is participating (in network) or non-participating (out of network).

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive, in network | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Basic, in network | 0 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 | 90 |
| Major, in network | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Preventive, out of network | 100 | 90 | 90 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Basic, out of network | 0 | 60 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 |
| Major, out of network | 0 | 0 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 60 |

All figures are percentages paid by the plan. A basic or major percentage of 0 means that the class is not covered for that network on that plan (for example, major services on Preventive 750 and Value 1000, and basic services on Preventive 750).

### Points of reading
- The in-network columns apply to practices treated as participating for the plan; the out-of-network rows apply to non-participating practices.
- Reading example: a basic-class line on Value 1000 is paid at 70 percent when the practice is participating and at 60 percent when it is not; on Elite 2500 the same two lines are paid at 90 percent either way.
